title: Meeting assistant
description: When the meeting assistant wakes, how it answers, and which tools, MCP servers and skills it may use.
appliesText: A saved change applies within about five minutes, to transcript segments processed and answers started after that.

wakePhraseRegex.title: Wake phrase (regular expression)
wakePhraseRegex.description: Python regular expression that, when found in a transcript segment, sends it to the meeting assistant.

promptCachingEnabled.title: Use Amazon Bedrock prompt caching
promptCachingEnabled.description: Cache the repeated part of the assistant's prompts to lower model cost; answers are unchanged.

assistantReasoningEffort.title: Reasoning effort
assistantReasoningEffort.description: How much the model reasons before answering; higher is slower and costs more. Claude 5 models only.

webSearchEnabled.title: Web search
webSearchEnabled.description: Offer web search (Tavily) to the assistant. Off turns it off for every request. Needs a Tavily API key.

mcpServersEnabled.title: MCP servers
mcpServersEnabled.description: Let the meeting assistant use installed MCP servers. Off turns them off for every request.

inMeetingRequestTools.title: Participant use
inMeetingRequestTools.description: What the assistant may use to answer meeting participants (anyone but the owner and shared users).

enumLabels.unrestricted: Unrestricted: every tool, acting for the meeting's owner
enumLabels.selected: Selected tools: the current meeting, plus the tools switched on below

inMeetingWebSearch.title: Participant use: web search
inMeetingWebSearch.description: With Selected tools, offer web search to participants. Queries are sent to Tavily.

inMeetingDocumentSearch.title: Participant use: document knowledge base
inMeetingDocumentSearch.description: With Selected tools, offer the document knowledge base to participants, who see what it returns.

inMeetingMeetingHistory.title: Participant use: the owner's past meetings
inMeetingMeetingHistory.description: With Selected tools, let participants search the owner's past meetings, acting as the owner.

inMeetingMcpServers.title: Participant use: MCP servers
inMeetingMcpServers.description: With Selected tools, offer installed MCP servers to participants, using each server's own credentials.

inMeetingVpControls.title: Participant use: Virtual Participant controls
inMeetingVpControls.description: With Selected tools, offer the Virtual Participant browser controls to participants in the meeting.

inMeetingSkills.title: Participant use: skills
inMeetingSkills.description: With Selected tools, offer skills to participants, unless a skill's Tool selection row says otherwise.

inMeetingContextAccess.title: Participant use: meeting context and checklist
inMeetingContextAccess.description: Whether requests made in the meeting may read its context and checklist; answers are seen by everyone.

enumLabels.none: None: only the meeting page's assistant (default)
enumLabels.allowed: Allowed: requests made in the meeting may read them

inMeetingRequesters.title: Participant use: who may ask
inMeetingRequesters.description: Who in the meeting may ask the assistant; the meeting page's own chat is never affected.

enumLabels.owner_only: Owner only: the wake phrase on the LMA user's own microphone
enumLabels.off: Off: no requests made in the meeting

systemPrompt.title: Assistant instructions
systemPrompt.description: The editable part of the assistant's instructions; LMA always appends a fixed part.

omitSensitivePersonalInformation.title: Leave out sensitive personal information
omitSensitivePersonalInformation.description: Tell the assistant to leave sensitive personal information out of answers. An instruction, not a filter.

toolSelection.title: Tool selection
toolSelection.description: Per MCP server and skill, whether the assistant may use it for the owner and for participants.

mcpServers.title: MCP servers
mcpServers.description: Per installed MCP server: Owner use, Participant use, and Always on (reserved, not yet used).

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Per skill: Owner use, Participant use, and Always on (reserved, not yet used).

guidance.title: Live guidance
guidance.description: Checklist tracking and short suggestions shown to the owner during a meeting. Each run is a billed model call.

defaultEnabled.title: On for new meetings
defaultEnabled.description: Whether new meetings start with live guidance on; each meeting can still turn it on or off.

intervalSeconds.title: Seconds between runs
intervalSeconds.description: Minimum time between two runs on one meeting; longer means fewer model calls.

minNewSegments.title: New transcript segments a run needs
minNewSegments.description: A run is skipped until at least this many new transcript segments have arrived.

maxItemsPer10Min.title: Guidance items per 10 minutes
maxItemsPer10Min.description: Most guidance items per meeting in any 10 minutes; 0 shows none but still updates the checklist.

confidenceThreshold.title: Confidence threshold
confidenceThreshold.description: Items and checklist changes below this model confidence (0 to 1) are dropped; higher is quieter.

modelId.title: Model
modelId.description: The Amazon Bedrock model that reads the meeting.

enumLabels: The Meeting assistant model (Amazon Bedrock Models section)

maxRunsPerMeeting.title: Runs per meeting at most
maxRunsPerMeeting.description: Most runs per meeting, capping its cost; 0 turns live guidance off for the deployment.

prompt.title: Instructions
prompt.description: The editable part of each run's instructions; LMA always appends a fixed part.

whiteboards.title: Whiteboards
whiteboards.description: Markdown or diagram panels the assistant can keep up to date during a meeting. Each run is a billed model call.

defaultEnabled.title: On for new meetings
defaultEnabled.description: Whether new meetings start with assistant whiteboard updates on; each meeting can still change it.

intervalSeconds.title: Seconds between runs
intervalSeconds.description: Minimum time between two runs on one meeting; longer means fewer model calls.

minNewSegments.title: New transcript segments a run needs
minNewSegments.description: A run is skipped until at least this many new transcript segments have arrived.

maxRunsPerMeeting.title: Runs per meeting at most
maxRunsPerMeeting.description: Most assistant runs per meeting, capping its cost; 0 turns updates off (hand editing still works).

maxWhiteboardsPerMeeting.title: Whiteboards per meeting
maxWhiteboardsPerMeeting.description: The most whiteboards one meeting may have.

modelId.title: Model
modelId.description: The Amazon Bedrock model that updates the whiteboards.

enumLabels: The Meeting assistant model (Amazon Bedrock Models section)

prompt.title: Instructions
prompt.description: The editable part of each run's instructions; LMA always appends a fixed part.

playbooks.title: Meeting playbooks
playbooks.description: Playbooks are skills that set a meeting up: whiteboards, live guidance checks and chat quick actions. Chosen per meeting; written on the Skills page.

defaultPlaybook.title: Default playbook
defaultPlaybook.description: Applied to each new meeting that is not given one; a Virtual Participant can choose another or none. Empty: no playbook unless one is chosen.
